ctx.x: So some more dates come in, and instead of us coming back to New York, and Claud say I got two or three more dates, can you make them? I said well, yes, I guess so, you know. And since I hadn't heard anything, I said two or three more dates are not going to hurt. And one -- this particular date took us to West Virginia, and Fats' booking came in, because the thing in Chicago, the hotel in Chicago had the room. He didn't mention it to me, and that -- now that's where Fats was like a kid. He would get very mad,…
You'd say well, he left town. He left town.
